Coding Is Everywhere Author: Maggie Johnson Illustrator: Ma'ayan Rosenzweig
Coding is like a super secret language...
... but you don't have to be a superhero or a secret agent to use it.
Code is written on a computer.
It helps make amazing things all around us.
Coding is used to create many of your favorite movies and video games.
It helps design buildings, bridges, and amusement park rides.
Coding is even used to make flying robots, self-driving cars, and machines that help doctors save lives!
Want to know the real secret about coding?
It isn’t a secret at all!
All you need to start coding is a computer and your curiosity!
